title: UI风格#25 - Paper Cutout (纸艺浮雕)
description: 创建第25种UI风格：纸艺浮雕风格 - 层叠纸张、剪纸艺术、柔和阴影。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout style When color palette Then features craft paper tones, soft neons on cream backgrounds
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#F5E6D3 (牛皮纸), #E8D5B7 (米色), #FF6B6B (珊瑚红), #4ECDC4 (薄荷绿), #FFE66D (柠檬黄)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout style When typography Then uses handcrafted fonts: Shadows Into Light, Covered By Your Grace, or Patrick Hand
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Shadows Into Light (标题), Covered By Your Grace (装饰), Nunito (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout style When layout Then layered paper shapes, cutout shadows, craft textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：层叠纸片、剪纸阴影、工艺纹理、纸张质感

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout style When UI elements Then torn edges, paper fold effects, subtle textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：撕裂边缘、纸张折叠效果、微妙纹理、弹出层次

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout UI When functional Then includes paper chat, cutout agents, craft stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：纸艺聊天、剪纸代理、手工统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Paper Cutout UI When copy Then uses craft language: 'Fold', 'Layer', 'Craft', 'Create'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'FOLD. LAYER. CRAFT.'、按钮'SEND'→'FOLD'、'SUBMIT'→'CREATE'
